text: The Board confirms that each of these nominees is qualified to serve under the provisions of the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework for Community Centre Boards of Management. Please note that the term of the following member has now come to an end: - Sheila Potwin resigned effective September 10,2024. On behalf of the Board, I respectfully request that the City take the necessary steps to appoint these nominated candidates.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following individuals to the Central Eglinton Community Centre Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending September 10, 2026 and until successors are appointed: - Nancy Haddad-Albina - Ellen Fisher - Harriet Velazquez - Celine Devlin - James Sutcliffe
